decisions.reason: The camera sits close to the firm's core offer and has its own web page, and with industry turnover growing, hiring and ample slack, nothing signals a shortfall that would prompt search for alternatives.

The modular navigation camera line has several models, matches the firm's move toward compact flexible sensors and builds on its space heritage, so results likely meet aspirations and the firm has the slack to carry it.

The space situational awareness suite is a little further from the core and its results are less certain, but growing demand in this field and the firm's R&D slack and research networks favour keeping it.

The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned on the website, which suggests weaker visibility and some risk of falling short, but it is close to the firm's docking know-how and fits its small-satellite direction, so a firm with this much slack would likely carry it through the long space-qualification cycle.
